properties.site-address: Fire Station, Ifield Avenue, West Green, Crawley
properties.notes: Identified in the Local Plan Housing Trajectory as a Broad Location for residential development. Potential for development of the site will vary according to whether or not the fire station remains on site. Minimum figure of 0 reflects the fact that an all-commercial development scheme may be acceptable. Maximum figure of 48 units based on the figure given in the Crawley Borough Local Plan Housing Trajectory, and assumes removal of fire station from the site.
